description: A gable roof: the room's short edges, 1 and 3, are gables, and its long edges slope at 6 in 12. The eaves overhang 300 mm and the gables, at the rake, 150 mm of their own: the ridge runs the whole length of the outline, past the gable ends, which stand on the walls 150 mm inside the rake (16.5): each rises from the eave to the surface over its wall - 150 mm at its corners, where the eaves are 300 mm out - and to the ridge between them.
